description: The chart illustrates two metrics for four prompting/reasoning methods—accuracy and token count—shown as two side-by-side bar groups. The horizontal axis contains the method categories (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT) in that left-to-right order, with no explicit x-axis label. The left vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale from 70 to 100 with evenly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals; the right vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 800 with tick marks every 100. In the left group (accuracy), the bars are colored red for CoT (91.19), orange for CoD (80.89), light blue for CCoT (approximately 88–89; the bar top sits just below 90 and is accompanied by a small gray cap/overlay near 90), and green for CoUT (88.40). In the right group (token count), the bars use the same colors and correspond to CoT at 676.85 (red), CoD at 534.24 (orange), CCoT at 445.91 (light blue), and CoUT at 354.46 (green). Values are printed above most bars, and the bars are not presented as stacked; they are grouped by metric (accuracy on the left, token count on the right) rather than sorted by magnitude, with no additional highlighting beyond the numeric annotations and the small gray overlay on the CCoT accuracy bar.
